cards.ex: Send it whenever you can — no rush.
I skipped breakfast today. → Oops, I spilled my coffee! (skip a meal/class, spill A on B)
Oh, that was your seat? My bad!
Can you lend me your charger? → The deposit is 50,000 won. (lend 사람 물건 = ~에게 빌려주다)
I'm so tired today. — Same here.

quiz.q: Take your time with the report — ___ .
quiz.note: No rush = 급할 거 없어요. 상대 부담을 덜어주는 한마디!

quiz.q: I ___ lunch because I was too busy.
quiz.note: skip a meal/class = 건너뛰다. 회화에서 정말 자주 써요.

quiz.q: Sorry, I took your pen by mistake. ___ !
quiz.note: My bad = 제 실수(가볍고 캐주얼). 진지한 사과엔 I'm sorry!

quiz.q: Could you ___ me 10,000 won until tomorrow?
quiz.note: lend = 빌려주다 / borrow = 빌리다. 주어가 주는 쪽이면 lend!
Same here = 저도요. Me too와 같은 뜻, 더 자연스러운 회화체.

cards.ex: Let me know how the meeting goes — keep me posted.
The test detected a problem. → We overlooked a small detail. (detect = 찾아내다, overlook = 못 보고 넘어가다)
For the time being, let's work from home.
Is the budget adequate? → Moderate exercise is good for you. (adequate = 필요한 만큼은 되는)
I don't need exact numbers — just a ballpark figure.

quiz.q: Let me know if anything changes — ___ .
quiz.note: Keep me posted = 계속 알려 주세요. 이메일·카톡 마무리 단골!

quiz.q: We ___ one important mistake in the contract.
quiz.note: overlook = 간과하다. look over(훑어보다)와 뜻이 달라요!
for the time being = 당분간. 전치사 for 고정!

quiz.q: Walking 30 minutes a day is ___ exercise.
I don't need the exact cost — just give me ___ .
quiz.note: a ballpark figure = 대충 어림잡은 숫자. 견적·예산 얘기 단골!

cards.expr: bite off more than you can chew
cards.ex: I took three projects at once — I bit off more than I could chew.
Change is inevitable. → The problem is widespread. (it's inevitable that ~)
Let's not jump the gun — wait for the final results.
We endured a tough year. → Now the business is thriving. (thrive on = ~을 즐기며 잘 해내다)
He's new here — cut him some slack.

quiz.q: Don't take on five projects — you'll ___ .
quiz.hint: 씹을 수 있는 것보다 더 많이 베어 물다
accept: bite off more than you can chew
quiz.note: 감당 못 할 만큼 일을 벌이는 것. 과거형은 bit off more than I could chew.

quiz.q: With prices rising, a delay was ___ .
quiz.note: inevitable = 결국 일어날 수밖에 없는. It's inevitable that ~.

quiz.q: We haven't signed yet — don't ___ and tell everyone.
quiz.note: jump the gun = 신호 전에 출발하다 → 성급하게 굴다.
thrive under pressure = 압박 속에서 더 잘 해내다. endure는 '버티다'.
cut someone some slack = 너그럽게 봐주다. 사람 자리에 him/me/them 다 가능!
